messages.author: ea0933a6725a48c6
messages.subject: Request for help with ggplot2 in R 2.14.1
parts:
I am writing to ask for the community's help with ggplot2 in R 2.14.1. I am working in a 32-bit Linux environment (Ubuntu-LXLE). I am experimenting with an older version of ggplot2 that is compatible with my version of R. 

My first attempt is to work with ggplot2 0.8. I downloaded the following packages from CRAN and was able to install them in R via the terminal:

  • grid - native to R version
  • reshape - 0.8.2
  • plyr - 1.2.1
  • proto - 0.3-9.1
  • RColorBrewer - 1.0-2
  • splines - native to R version
  • MASS - native to R version
However, after I load the library for ggplot2, R does not recognize either ggplot() or qplot(). Below is an excerpt from my terminal:

> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr
Loading required package: proto
Loading required package: RColorBrewer
Loading required package: splines
Loading required package: MASS
> 
> ggplot()
Error: could not find function "ggplot"
> 
> ?ggplot
No documentation for ‘ggplot’ in specified packages and libraries:
you could try ‘??ggplot’
> 

I would appreciate any advice on how to troubleshoot. Thanks!
